_comment: ad-cut v0.5.0 keyword buckets — by speaker role + content type, not by hardcoded format. Stage 1 flattens all buckets into the keyword list passed to Stage 3 segment-level match. Stage 4 prompt uses bucket names to weight LLM judgments.

format_sponsor.description: 硬格式赞助词(传统 TV/电台植入)
keywords: 本节目由 X 赞助
感谢 X 独家冠名

host_chitchat.description: 片头寒暄 / 主播带货引导(直播带货典型词)

company_intro.description: 公司介绍 / 品牌介绍(电商线下课常见)
keywords: 教育咨询数制产业资本

speaker_transition.description: 主讲人切换 / 调讲台 / 杂项(锚定内容切换节点)

mid_roll_promo.description: 中段讲师休息+密集推销(电商课最常见漏判场景)

cta_engagement.description: 互动引导(扣关键词、加微信、扫码)

tail_farewell.description: 末尾告别+带货(收尾阶段常混推销)

_usage.stage_1: Flatten all buckets into one keyword list (sorted, deduped) before passing to claude -p for LLM expansion
_usage.stage_3: Pass flattened list as --keywords to stage3_match.py (segment-level mode default)
_usage.stage_4: Use bucket names in LLM prompt to weight by category (e.g. 'speaker_transition is high signal even alone')
